driver: eval/runners/headless-match.ts with cpuDefensiveTackle:true, lifecyclePhaseSync:'legacy', and the gated detectFouls observation extension (FOUL-DETECTION-MACHINERY); plus the driven proximate-5v5 stream via the accepted defensive-duel-driver with the pure detectFoulEvents read.

activation.meaning: the runner injects, as observation-level annotations, a `foul` event into the matching-tick observation for every committed man-not-ball tackle contact (a player-player-contact with contactType ∈ {standing-tackle, slide-tackle}, tacklePhase === 'active', duelWon === false). Off (the default) the stream is byte-identical to every accepted run. Cards, advantage and free-kicks stay spec-only (not implemented).

disclosures: FOUL-DETECT / FOUL-CLEAN-TACKLE are NAMED-BUT-UNREGISTERED criteria (FOULS_CARDS_SPEC §10): no evaluator suite, oracle, invariant, binding or scenario registration accompanies this objective, and no suite verdict is reported for them. That is the next objective (FOULS-SUITE-REGISTRATION).
Cards, advantage and free-kicks stay spec-only (not implemented): no card event, no advantage-window logic, no free-kick restart exists. Only the §5.1 man-not-ball foul read is emitted.

The driven stream uses the accepted defensive-duel-driver (scripted standing tackle) and applies the pure detectFoulEvents read; the runHeadlessMatch runner gate (detectFouls) is exercised by the organic live + stashed runs. The detection predicate is identical in both (the same exported function).

The detection is an observation-level annotation (the gk-role / restart-designation precedent): git diff src/simulation/ and src/contracts/ are empty; the core, its event union and its contracts are untouched, and detectFouls:false is byte-identical to the pre-change baseline.
No criterion is upgraded beyond what the executed read returns; a foul is reported only where a genuine man-not-ball contact is committed. No forced outcome.

runs.role: proximate 5v5 human-vs-CPU (defensive-duel-driver) with a scripted standing tackle at earliestTick 48: the committed contact is a man-not-ball tackle (duelWon false, ballReachable false, tacklePhase active) — a genuine foul candidate. The pure detectFoulEvents read emits the `foul` event.
runs.reproduction: runDefensiveDuel({ scenario: withProximateHumanDefence(load("eval/scenarios/5v5-human-vs-cpu.v1.json")), maxTicks: 120, attempts: [{ kind: "standing", commitDistance: 3.0, earliestTick: 48 }] }) + detectFoulEvents(observations)

runs.role: coherent 3v3 CPU-vs-CPU (3v3-press) with cpuDefensiveTackle:true and the runner gate detectFouls:true — a real man-not-ball contact emerges organically and is emitted as a `foul` event.
runs.reproduction: runHeadlessMatch({ scenario: load("eval/scenarios/3v3-press-scenario.v1.json"), maxTicks: 600, cpuAntiHuddle: true, lifecyclePhaseSync: "legacy", cpuDefensiveTackle: true, detectFouls: true })

runs.role: the SAME organic match with detectFouls:false — stash-identity control: state-hash chain identical to the gated run, 0 injected `foul` events, byte-identical to the pre-change baseline.
runs.reproduction: runHeadlessMatch({ scenario: load("eval/scenarios/3v3-press-scenario.v1.json"), maxTicks: 600, cpuAntiHuddle: true, lifecyclePhaseSync: "legacy", cpuDefensiveTackle: true, detectFouls: false })
